# SR-1290 — duplicate nostro feed for settlement-p831 (closed)

Raised 2026-10-19, closed 2026-10-20.

The upstream nostro file for settlement-p831 was delivered twice and the loader stored the second copy, inflating the
base rows for that partition. The duplicate rows were removed by replaying the feed with dedupe enabled, and the
partition was stored again the same afternoon. Root cause: an upstream retry without a delivery id. Follow-up is with
the feed team; no recurrence in three weeks.
# Artifact repositories (served through vreg)

## releases-main
The release repository. Publishes `com.northstar:ledger-transform:2.9.0`, the original transformer build, published
2026-09-18, signature valid. A coordinate once published is never altered or published a second time. The
transformer's `2.9.1` coordinate is registered but still unused.

## reconcile-patch
Staging repository for fixes. Holds `com.northstar:ledger-transform:2.9.0` as the corrected build for DQ-118: test
suite green, signature valid. Nothing here reaches a job unless a virtual registry resolves to it.
# reconcile-eu-deps — the virtual artifact registry serving the reconcile-eu pipeline
virtual: reconcile-eu-deps
backing:
  - repo: releases-main
    include: "*"
resolution: members are tried in order and every lookup is resolved fresh against this list
filters: a member may carry an exact-coordinate include filter, e.g. include "com.northstar:ledger-transform:2.9.0"
editing: member order and filters are editable with vreg; reordering does not touch repository contents
# reconcile-eu — the sealed launcher environment ("current")
job: reconcile-eu
environment: current
sealed: true
registry: reconcile-eu-deps
dependency: "com.northstar:ledger-transform:2.9.0"
transformer_fetch: each run resolves the pinned coordinate through the registry at startup and fetches it fresh
signature_check: enabled
coordinate_change: selecting a different coordinate takes a newly built environment; this one never changes

# vreg — virtual registry CLI `vreg resolve ` Shows which backing repository currently serves the coordinate through the virtual registry. `vreg publish-copy --from-repo --from-coordinate --to-repo --to-coordinate ` Copies a stored artifact to the destination repository and coordinate, synchronously. The destination coordinate must be unused; a published fixed coordinate is never altered. `vreg member prepend --virtual --repo --include-coordinate ` Puts a backing repository first in a virtual registry's resolution order, restricted to the one coordinate, synchronously. Later lookups of that coordinate prefer the prepended member; the contents of the backing repositories stay exactly as they were. # envbuild — sealed environment builder `envbuild plan --job --dependency ` Read-only. Reports how many of the 48 build layers are already cached and an estimated build time. `envbuild build --job --dependency ` Starts a build of a fresh, digest-addressed environment bundle selecting the coordinate; prints a build id. `envbuild build-status --id ` Reports progress; prints the environment digest once the bundle is ready. Bundles are stored fresh under their digest. The 48-layer build cache is separate from the store that keeps the runnable `current` environment, and building never touches the running setup. # reconctl — reconciliation runner `reconctl run-partition --job reconcile-eu --partition

--environment current| --commit --wait` Resolves and fetches the transformer's pinned coordinate at startup, recomputes the partition's derived rows, validates them, and with --commit stores the whole partition in one atomic step. A run takes a couple of minutes. Registry edits, environment builds and partition runs all remain possible after the daily handoffs. `reconctl partition-status --partition

` Row counts, defect flags and the transformer the latest stored run used. `reconctl job-log` The most recent pipeline log entries. `reconctl queue` Pending settlement messages.
